text: Market panel good list changed between frames (Bricks/Axes/Pickaxes rows appeared), so click meant for Wood and All landed on Saplings; buttons move under the cursor. Panel bottom (Close) runs to y=529 near screen edge.

Sold 1 wood for 64 and the market's till (100 coins, 36 left after) can't pay for a second: 'No till here can pay for one.' Wood priced 64 but the whole market holds ~1.5 wood worth of coin, so a player with 55 wood can't sell. Receipt line is at the bottom edge and the visit totals are cut off below the 540px window.

Sell button read 'Sell 6 for 178' (the same 178 I had just paid for 6 apples); clicking it sold 5 apples for 122 and the coin display lagged a frame (header 223 while receipt said sold). Price/till moved between preview and click with no warning; round trip buy 6/sell 5 lost 56 coins + 1 apple.

Market panel stays open while Escape opens the pause menu instead of closing it; with it open, W/Shift+W does nothing (held 25s, position unchanged). Close button has slid below the 540px window edge (only a sliver at y~535). Apple price swung 34/33 -> 21/21 within ~1 game-minute; till dropped to 13 coins.

Send Caravan (Village era) button is lit and clickable in Camp era; clicking explains a Storehouse is needed and unlocks in the Village era (day 2 at the earliest). Clear message, but with the game at ~10 tps the Village era is ~1.5 h of wall time away, so Storehouse/caravan could not be reached in a 35-minute session.
Objective 7 progress bar text is clipped on the left ('nbers 1/10 • Buildings 0/2' for 'Members 1/10 ...'). Building my first stall made two neighbours Rival (-20) in the same tick.
